intro: Wind Rider is a Horde quest offered by Elu atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Aspiring to become a wind rider himself, Elu tasks adventurers with climbing into the craggy heights of Highperch to gather wild wyvern eggs to bolster the Horde's aerial mount reserves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've been tasked to recruit more wyverns for the master wind riders. Their numbers are growing and I myself hope to become a wind rider one day. However, we cannot train enough wyverns to keep up with the demand. Perhaps you can help me, friend.

I need you to travel to Highperch to gather some wyvern eggs. From here, head northwest along the canyon walls to a ramp that will lead you into Highperch. Be careful, wyverns are very protective over their eggs and they will not be kind to intruders.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Perfect! With these eggs I hope to take the next step to become a wind rider. Here is a token of my appreciation; may good hunting always shine upon you, adventurer.
